function: Over-the-air FL aggregation: AoI-based device selection plus transmit power and receive normalizing factor for AirComp. Excluded as system: single-antenna BS and single-antenna devices, no RIS (p. 2).
notes: Reason system (code 6), p. 2: "an edge server at a single-antenna base station (BS) coordinates N single-antenna edge devices"; the channels are scalar i.i.d. Rayleigh fading (p. 9: "modeled as independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) Rayleigh fading channels"), there is no RIS in the system model, and the work is neither OTFS nor NTN. Earlier codes do not apply: it is a research article that proposes and evaluates a method; no_learning does not apply because it is FL over the air (p. 2: "AirComp is used to aggregate model updates"; p. 9: ResNet-18 global model trained on non-IID CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100), even though FedAirAoI itself is non-learned optimization (Lyapunov priorities, greedy selection, KKT closed form, pp. 1-2); above_phy does not apply because device selection (p. 6, problem P1) is solved together with the physical-layer transmit power and receive normalizing factor that minimize the AirComp MSE (pp. 5-6: "jointly optimize the transmit power allocated to each device and the receive normalizing factor"); function fits area 7, since the paper solves the over-the-air aggregation itself. Identity: the PDF is arXiv:2501.01828v1 (p. 1); its title and authors match the Crossref record of the DOI (Liu, Chang, Liang, IEEE Transactions on Communications, 2026), checked on 21 October 2026.
